title: Protocol for isolating adult pituitary stem/progenitor cells in mice
protocol: Euthanize the mice by isoflurane overexposure.
Spray the work area with 75% (v/v) ethanol to create a sterile environment.
Perform decapitation using sterile surgical tools.
Peel the head skin between the ears gently.
Insert scissors along the dotted line toward the ears and open the skull using leverage principles.
Gently insert a medicine spoon between the brain and skull at the indicated position and scrape out the brain.
Remove the diaphragma sellae with sharp tweezers without damaging the pituitary gland.
Pinch the thin membrane at both ends of the pituitary gland with tweezers.
Flip the pituitary gland in two places toward the ventral side to remove the diaphragma sellae.
Trim surrounding tissue to access the pituitary gland more easily.
Grasp the pituitary gland gently with blunt tweezers and transfer it to a 35-mm plastic dish containing 2 mL of HBSS.
Discard the intermediate lobe (IL) and posterior lobe (PL) from the pituitary gland under a stereomicroscope.
Poke the tip of the tweezers into the border area between the anterior lobe (AL) and the IL.
Using pierced tweezers as support, peel off the IL/PL with opposite tweezers.
Transfer the AL to a new 35-mm plastic dish filled with 2 mL of fresh HBSS.
Isolate the AL carefully with sharp tweezers split into two pieces to increase surface area for enzymatic reaction.
Collect the AL fragments in a new 35-mm plastic dish filled with 1.8 mL of AM.
Add 0.2 mL of 2% collagenase solution to the dish and mix by pipetting.
Transfer the AL fragments (with AM) to a 15-mL conical tube using a micropipette.
Incubate the mixture in a water bath at 37°C for 15 min.
Mix the conical tube by tapping it once every 5 minutes during incubation.
Add 5 μL of DNase I solution to the mixture after removing it from the water bath.
Tap the conical tube 5 times and then incubate at 37°C for 5 min.
Centrifuge the mixture at 100 × g for 5 min at 20°C–25°C.
Remove the supernatant using a pipette after centrifugation.
Add 2 mL of digestion buffer A to the pellet and incubate at 37°C for 5 min.
Add 2 mL of AM to stop the trypsin reaction after the incubation period.
Centrifuge the mixture again at 100 × g for 5 min at 20°C–25°C.
Remove the supernatant using a pipette after centrifugation.
Add 2 mL of fresh AM to the pellet.
Dissociate the AL into single cells by aspirating and expelling the contents with a micropipette (dial set to 1,000 μL) approximately 10–20 times until fragments are no longer visible.
Count the number of primary AL cells.
Seed at 75,000 cells per 500 μL on the glass surface of a glass-bottom dish.
Transfer the seeded dish to a CO2 incubator with 5% CO2 and 95% air.
Preculture the cells at 37°C for 30–60 minutes.
Make a droplet to ensure the culture fluid does not overflow from the glass surface.
Drip the culture medium around the droplet carefully.
Add 1.5 mL of fresh AM to the glass-bottom dish with a drop.
Incubate until the next day.
Replace growth medium and incubate for another 6 days.
Change the entire culture medium every three days.
Remove the culture medium using a micropipette (P1000) for changing the medium.
Rinse twice with 1 mL of HBSS.
Add 2 mL of growth medium and incubate in a CO2 incubator at 37°C.
Proceed to the next step after a total of 7 days of cell culture.
Photograph cells using ECLIPSE Ts2-FL.
Remove the culture medium using a micropipette set to 1,000 μL.
Rinse twice with 1 mL of HBSS.
Lyse cells by adding 100 μL of LB1 onto the glass surface for 5 min at 20°C–25°C.
Extract total RNA using the NucleoSpin RNA Plus XS kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Measure the concentration of extracted RNA using an absorption photometer such as NanoDrop.
Synthesize complementary DNA (cDNA) from 250–500 ng of total RNA.
Heat the mixture at 65°C for 5 min and cool immediately on ice.
Prepare the reaction mixture by combining specified components to a total volume of 20 μL.
Perform the reaction at 42°C for 60 min.
Heat the reaction mixture at 70°C for 15 min and cool on ice.
Dilute with sterile water to achieve a cDNA concentration derived from 10 ng/μL total RNA equivalent.
Store the diluted cDNA at −30°C until use.
Add 9.5 μL of the premix followed by 0.5 μL of diluted cDNA to 8-stripe tubes or a 96-well plate.
Mix and centrifuge briefly.
Perform qRT-PCR using a CFX Connect Real-Time PCR Detection System according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
Calculate relative gene expression by comparing cycle times for each targeted PCR.
Normalize target gene expression levels using TATA-box-binding protein as an internal standard gene (ΔCt).
Remove the culture medium using a micropipette.
Rinse twice with 1 mL of HBSS.
Fix the cells by adding 180 μL of the 4% PFA solution onto the glass surface of the glass-bottom dish for 20 min at 20°C–25°C.
Remove the 4% PFA solution using a micropipette.
Wash the cells three times for 5 min each with 1 mL of HBSS.
Permeabilize the cells by adding 180 μL of HEPES-T with 10% normal donkey serum onto the glass surface of the glass-bottom dish.
Incubate at 20°C–25°C for 60 min.
Remove the blocking buffer using a micropipette.
Add 180 μL of primary antibody mixes diluted in the blocking buffer onto the glass surface.
Incubate at 20°C–25°C for 12–16 h.
Remove the antibody solution using a micropipette.
Wash the cells three times for 5 min each with 1 mL of HBSS.
Add 180 μL of secondary antibodies diluted in the blocking buffer onto the glass surface.
Incubate at 20°C–25°C for 1 h.
Remove the antibody solution using a micropipette.
Wash the cells three times for 5 min each with 1 mL of HBSS.
Stain the nucleus by adding 100 μL of VECTASHIELD Mounting Medium with DAPI onto the glass surface.
Incubate at 20°C–25°C for 2 h.
Perform fluorescence observation using a fluorescence microscope.
Acquire immunofluorescent images using imaging software.
Remove the culture medium using a micropipette.
Wash twice with 1 mL of HBSS.
Add 2 mL of digestion buffer B.
Incubate at 37°C for 15 min.
Add 2 mL of DM to stop the trypsin reaction.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 15-mL conical tube using a micropipette (P1000).
Centrifuge at 100 × g for 5 min at 20°C–25°C.
Remove the supernatant.
Add 2 mL of fresh DM.
Suspend into single cells by aspirating and expelling the AL with a micropipette (dial is set to 1,000 μL) multiple times (approximately 10 times).
Seed at 5,000 cells/100 μL/1 well in non-adherent, U-bottom 96-well plates.
Transfer to a CO2 incubator (5% CO2/95% air) and culture at 37°C for 4 days.
Collect all aggregates from one plate into a 15-mL conical tube using a micropipette (P200).
Centrifuge at 100 × g for 5 min at 20°C–25°C.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend aggregates in a small volume (up to 50 μL) of DM and keep on ice.
Solidify the sample into a jelly-like substance using the iPGell kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Add 1.3 mL of the 4% PFA solution and gently pipette the sample so that it peels off from the tube.
Fix samples by rotating for 1 h at 4°C.
Remove the 4% PFA solution using a micropipette.
Rinse samples with 1 mL of HBSS.
Remove HBSS using a micropipette.
Immerse samples in a 30% trehalose solution for 24 hours at 4°C.
Embed the sample in O.C.T. Compound and store at -80°C.
Section the frozen sample to a thickness of 8 μm.
Mount the sectioned sample on glass slides.
Perform immunofluorescence analysis as described from step 41 through step 47.
Adjust the volume of all solutions, including antibody mixes, to 50 μL.
